name: fbi-crime-mcp-server
description: Exposes the FBI Crime Data Explorer API — monthly UCR offense rates and counts, hate crime, arrest, and NIBRS breakdowns by national, state, or agency scope, agency ORI search, and LEOKA officer-safety statistics via MCP. STDIO or Streamable HTTP.

interface.shortDescription: Exposes the FBI Crime Data Explorer API — monthly UCR offense rates and counts, hate crime, arrest, and NIBRS breakdowns by national, state, or agency scope, agency ORI search, and LEOKA officer-safety statistics via MCP.
interface.longDescription: Six callable tools expose FBI Crime Data Explorer monthly offense rates, counts, population denominators, reporting coverage and optional comparison rates at national, state or agency scope; hate crime, arrest and NIBRS totals at the same scopes; agency ORI search from the CDE state directory; and LEOKA officer fatality trends with circumstance, demographic, timeline and weapon detail. Runs over STDIO or Streamable HTTP. Five retired UCR tools remain disabled on the operator landing page; no resources are registered.
